data.name: Ramlal
data.gender_notes: Ramlal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ram means 'God' and Lal means 'in chariot'. This name signifies the presence and protection of God in one's life. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a baby boy. The name Ramlal carries the meaning “God in Chariot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramlal usually hope their child will grow to embody god in chariot and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramlal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramlal: The name Ramlal is a blend of two holy names - Ram and Hari (Lal). Ram signifies the divine name of the supreme God, Vishnu, while Hari denotes Lord Krishna. This name embodies the devotion and love for both these forms of the deity, emphasizing the unity and oneness of all gods.

historical_references.reference: Ramlal Chandra was a renowned mathematician and astronomer during the medieval period of India. He made significant contributions to trigonometry and is often considered the greatest Indian mathematician before Bhaskara II. He was a Jain monk and lived during the 12th century AD.

Ramlal Verma was a poet during the Mughal period of India. He wrote in the Hindi language and his works are considered milestones in the development of Hindi poetry. He is particularly known for his 'Chandrama' and 'Mrigtrishna'. He lived during the late 16th and early 17th centuries AD.
